rows.commentary: 6.5: Lalit Rajbanshi tests Ayush Badoni with a flat, good-length delivery on off and middle, which the batter meets with a forward defensive prod.
6.6: Lalit Rajbanshi outfoxes Ayush Badoni in flight as the batter charges down the track, beats him with sharp turn, and allows Deepak Dumre to complete an easy stumping.
7.1: Nandan Yadav bangs it back of a length and gets the ball to jag in, cramping Vaibhav Sooryavanshi for room as he punches toward cover with one hand releasing.
7.2: Nandan Yadav delivers a back-of-a-length ball angling into off stump, prompting Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to gently punch it toward the cover region.
7.3: Nandan Yadav draws a thick outside edge from Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's attempted off-side drive, sending the ball rolling down to third man for a single.
7.4: Nandan Yadav targets a wide channel outside off, leaving Tilak Varma with a comfortable decision to shoulder arms and watch it pass.
7.5: Nandan Yadav persists in the channel from a back-of-a-length spot, and Tilak Varma offers no stroke once again.
7.6: Nandan Yadav angles another delivery into the off-stump channel, where Tilak Varma comfortably raises his arms to leave it alone.
8.1: Pawan Sarraf fires a length delivery sliding into middle and leg, which Vaibhav Sooryavanshi solidly defends from his crease.
8.2: Pawan Sarraf drifts one into middle and leg, requiring Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to step forward with his bat positioned safely in front of his pad.
8.3: Pawan Sarraf sneaks a flatter delivery through Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's attempted pull shot, catching the batter on the thigh as he clears his front foot.
8.4: Pawan Sarraf tosses a full delivery outside off, allowing Vaibhav Sooryavanshi to ease a straightforward drive down to long-off for a single.
8.5: Pawan Sarraf extracts sharp grip from a good length, forcing Tilak Varma onto the back foot to safely dead-bat.
8.6: Pawan Sarraf tosses it up outside off, inviting a decisive stride from Tilak Varma as he punches it toward long-off for a single.
9.1: Nandan Yadav induces a flashing half-hearted cut from Tilak Varma, but Lokesh puts down a golden opportunity at gully, slamming the turf in sheer disbelief.
9.2: Nandan Yadav bowls a wide to Tilak Varma.
9.2: No run for Tilak Varma off Nandan Yadav.
20.5: Kushal Bhurtel drops it short to Kumar Kushagra, who reads the googly off the pitch and forces a single down to long-off off the back foot.
20.6: Kushal Bhurtel bowls to Tilak Varma, who stays back and steers it wide of short fine for a single to close out a six-run over.
21.1: Lalit Rajbanshi floats one up to Tilak Varma, who steps down the pitch with a firm stride to dead-bat it straight back to the bowler.
21.2: Lalit Rajbanshi loops it up to Tilak Varma, who waits for the turn on the back foot and taps it into the off-side for a single.
21.3: Lalit Rajbanshi fires a tossed-up delivery outside off to Kumar Kushagra, who gets forward to block it solidly.
21.4: Lalit Rajbanshi pitches it up to Kumar Kushagra, who unleashes a booming drive wide of cover to race a boundary to the deep extra-cover fence.
21.5: Lalit Rajbanshi deceives Kumar Kushagra in flight with a turning ball that squares the batter up before a sluggish surface lets him stab it away.
21.6: Lalit Rajbanshi bowls to Kumar Kushagra, who hangs back, opens the bat face, and strokes it with the turn into the gap at deep cover for a single.
22.1: Sandeep Lamichhane serves up a tossed-up delivery that Kumar Kushagra effortlessly drills down to long-off for a single.
22.2: Sandeep Lamichhane delivers to Tilak Varma, who dabs it into the off-side to scamper through for a brisk single.
22.3: Sandeep Lamichhane tosses it up to Kumar Kushagra, who strides forward and push-drives it straight down to long-off for another single.
22.4: Sandeep Lamichhane spins a sharp, low-keeping googly past Tilak Varma, who can only cue-end a bunt down towards cover.
22.5: Lamichhane drops it short and extracts turn away from Tilak Varma, who chops the googly firmly toward deep cover for a quick single.
22.6: Lamichhane angles a wide googly past Kumar Kushagra, who watches the delivery sail harmlessly through to the keeper without offering a shot.
23.1: Tilak Varma stabs Bhurtel's delivery into the off-side, snatching a single after a sharp fumble at point gives them the opening.
23.2: Kushagra drills Bhurtel's full offering down to long-off for a comfortable single, bringing up a vital fifty-run partnership for the pair.
23.3: Tilak Varma works Bhurtel's length delivery away toward the mid-wicket region to rotate the strike once more.
33.6: Nandan Yadav delivers a slower ball on a length, angled in, which Kumar Kushagra clips down to deep mid-wicket for a single.
34.1: Sandeep Lamichhane fires one turning away outside off, patted down to deep cover for a single.
34.2: Sandeep Lamichhane extracts massive turn into Tilak Varma, who misses the flick as a loud appeal for an inside edge is waved away while a single is stolen toward short third man.
34.3: Sandeep Lamichhane drops it short, prompting Kumar Kushagra to rock back and mistime a pull over mid-wicket that is cut off by a tumbling fielder to salvage two runs.
34.4: Sandeep Lamichhane tosses one up outside off, stabbed straight down to short third man by Kumar Kushagra.
34.5: Kumar Kushagra goes deep into his crease to punch Sandeep Lamichhane's delivery down to long-off for a single.
34.6: Tilak Varma plays a steady back-foot stroke against Sandeep Lamichhane's flatter googly, steering it down to long-off for a single.
35.1: Nandan Yadav angles a length delivery into the pads of Tilak Varma, who gently nudges it toward mid-wicket.
35.2: Nandan Yadav bangs it short and wide outside off, and Tilak Varma misses his slash as the ball skids through.
35.3: Nandan Yadav drifts onto the pads of Tilak Varma, who waits on the back-of-a-length delivery and wrists it away behind square for a boundary.
35.4: Nandan Yadav serves a back-of-a-length ball outside off, patted cleanly down wide of cover for a quick single.
35.5: Nandan Yadav lands a length delivery outside off, which Kumar Kushagra chops firmly down toward point.
35.6: Nandan Yadav delivers on a length, angled in, and Kumar Kushagra whips it down to long-on for a single as the partnership ticks along.
36.1: Sandeep Lamichhane fires it in, and Kumar Kushagra hangs back to chop the ball wide of point for a brisk single.
36.2: Sandeep Lamichhane bowls to Tilak Varma, who stabs it to point and nearly triggers an overthrow when the return eludes the bowler.
36.3: Sandeep Lamichhane produces a vicious grubber that crawls under Kumar Kushagra's attempted pull and nutmegs the wicketkeeper for four byes.
36.4: Sandeep Lamichhane tosses it up, and Kumar Kushagra drags his slog sweep down to deep midwicket for a single.
36.5: Sandeep Lamichhane attacks the pads, and Tilak Varma drops low to sweep flat and hard over backward square leg for a maximum.
36.6: Sandeep Lamichhane completes the over as Tilak Varma pushes the ball toward backward point for a single.
45.3: Nandan Yadav delivers a short-of-length ball outside off which Suryansh Shedge stabs down to the keeper off the inside edge.
45.4: Nandan Yadav bangs it in short outside off and Suryansh Shedge slaps it straight back to the bowler.
45.5: Nandan Yadav angles a length delivery in, allowing Suryansh Shedge to nudge a brace as Rinku Singh charges back with blistering pace for the second.
45.6: Nandan Yadav sends down a back-of-length ball that is angled in, nudged to square leg as they hare back for a brace.
46.1: Sandeep Lamichhane fires in a flatter googly that Rinku Singh dabs down to cover.
46.2: Sandeep Lamichhane tosses one up and draws a top-edged slog sweep from Rinku Singh, allowing Kushal Bhurtel to juggle twice at long-on before finally securing the catch.
46.3: Sandeep Lamichhane extracts extra bounce from a googly, forcing Shahbaz Ahmed to stab it sharply into the deck.
46.4: Sandeep Lamichhane watches as Shahbaz Ahmed pats the ball down into the off-side to scamper a single.
46.5: Sandeep Lamichhane extracts sharp turn away from Suryansh Shedge, who flashes his bat at a length ball outside off and misses entirely.
46.6: Sandeep Lamichhane tosses it up, and Suryansh Shedge shuffles across to launch a powerful heave over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
47.1: Nandan Yadav digs it in short outside off, and Shahbaz Ahmed slaps it down to long-on for a single without finding clean timing.
47.2: Nandan Yadav delivers a fuller ball outside off which Suryansh Shedge drags away toward long-on for a single.
47.3: Nandan Yadav feeds it full and angling in, allowing Shahbaz Ahmed to shuffle across and whip it wide of short fine leg for a boundary that brings up three hundred for India.
47.4: Nandan Yadav fires a very full delivery outside off which strikes Shahbaz Ahmed on the pads as he sweeps across the line, scampering two leg byes as the fielder cleans it up near the ring.
47.5: Nandan Yadav rolls out a slower delivery wide of off stump that beats Shahbaz Ahmed's wild attempted slap, prompting the umpire to signal a wide.
47.5: Nandan Yadav delivers a low full toss outside off that Shahbaz Ahmed cue-ends down towards deep mid-off to collect a single.
47.6: Nandan Yadav pitches it fuller and outside off, enabling Suryansh Shedge to get underneath the trajectory and launch a massive blow straight over long-off for six.
1.1: Prince Yadav pitches it on a good length in the channel, getting an outswinger to seam away and beat Deepak Dumre's tentative poke from the crease.
1.2: Prince Yadav serves a full outswinger outside off, enticing Deepak Dumre into a drive that entirely bypasses the bat.
1.3: Prince Yadav extracts more movement away from off on a back of a length, squaring up Deepak Dumre as he pokes past the edge.
1.4: Prince Yadav traps Deepak Dumre with a full outswinger outside off, inducing a leading edge off an on-side flick straight into the hands of Tilak Varma at mid-off.
1.5: Prince Yadav fires in an inswinging yorker just outside off, beating Basir Ahamad's hurried attempt to squeeze it out.
1.6: Prince Yadav bowls a pitched-up delivery from over the wicket that swings back in late, beating Basir Ahamad's inside edge as he drives with a static front foot to crash into off stump.
2.1: Harshit Rana drifts onto the pads of Kushal Bhurtel, who clips the ball directly to short midwicket.
2.2: Harshit Rana strays down leg, inducing a leading edge from Kushal Bhurtel that hangs in the air for Ayush Badoni to take at midwicket.
2.3: Harshit Rana delivers a full outswinger on middle, prompting Rashid Khan to hang back and work it towards midwicket.
2.4: Harshit Rana maintains a good length on middle, allowing Rashid Khan to comfortably nudge it toward midwicket once again.
2.5: Harshit Rana digs it in short of a length outside off, and Rashid Khan mistimes his attempted cut into the off-side.
2.6: Harshit Rana hits a good length in the channel, where Rashid Khan safely taps it down toward point.
3.1: Pawan Sarraf does not score off Prince Yadav.
3.2: Pawan Sarraf does not score off Prince Yadav.
9.3: Prince Yadav bowls a full, leg‑pad‑deflecting delivery to Sandeep Lamichhane that hits the leg stump and ends in a bowled dismissal.
9.4: Prince Yadav delivers a yorker outside off to Lalit Rajbanshi, who jabs it past the sixth stump but fails to make contact.
9.5: Prince Yadav throws a wide, well‑outside off, leaving Lalit Rajbanshi untouched.
9.5: Prince Yadav unleashes a lethal yorker wide of off stump, expertly jammed right back down the turf by Lalit Rajbanshi for a dot.
9.6: Prince Yadav bowls a back‑of‑a‑length channel ball to Lalit Rajbanshi, who punches it tamely and it is beaten on the edge.
10.1: Harshit Rana delivers a good‑length ball at the stumps to Nandan Yadav, who defends firmly with no run.
10.2: Harshit Rana bowls a full‑on off to Nandan Yadav, who swings hard but mistimes it, sending it through the vacant mid‑on.
10.3: Harshit Rana bowls a yorker at the toes to Nandan Yadav, who flicks it behind square for one run.
10.4: Harshit Rana bowls a back‑of‑a‑length channel ball to Lalit Rajbanshi, who leaves it alone but the ball carries to the keeper.
10.5: Harshit Rana bowls a full down‑leg to Lalit Rajbanshi, who is late on it and takes a hit on the pad.
10.6: Harshit Rana bowls a full‑on middle to Lalit Rajbanshi, who plays a straight bat and knocks it through the vacant mid‑off for two runs.
11.1: Shahbaz Ahmed tosses a wide‑line ball to Nandan Yadav, who reaches out and is beaten as it turns away.
11.2: Shahbaz Ahmed floats a turning delivery past Nandan Yadav's outside edge as the batter watches it pass.
11.3: Shahbaz Ahmed flights one up to draw Nandan Yadav down the track, beating the slog and handing Kumar Kushagra a simple stumping to seal Nepal's innings at 26.
